steps.title: Define Project Specifications
steps.description: Establish core project specifications with target SDK 34, min SDK 21, and namespace 'com.expensetrackerpro.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Configure build.gradle utilizing native Java 8 compilation settings and zero third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml referencing the application theme, launcher activity, and specifying proper package namespace structures.

steps.title: Create Transaction Model
steps.description: Design a clean Java Model representing a transaction, featuring ID, Amount, Type (Income vs Expense), Category, Description, and Date.

steps.title: Develop SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Program a high-performance DatabaseHelper targeting native SQLite implementation to support inserts, deletes, aggregates, and category reporting.

steps.title: Build Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Design main application layout showcasing simple bottom navigation bars, dynamic page views, dashboard indicators, form elements, and report summaries.

steps.title: Build Transaction Item Layout
steps.description: Design layout xml for representing singular financial records inside the list adapter.

steps.title: Build Category Report Row Layout
steps.description: Design layout xml for displaying categories alongside calculated expense aggregates inside reports view.

steps.title: Program Core App Logic
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java implementation encompassing UI navigation state machines, financial aggregation computations, and input form validations.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Initiate compilation using Native Gradle commands and package production-ready APK.
